prompt_head:
Role: Staff Software Engineer, AI Engineering at Tebra
<requirements>
[r1] (required, years_experience) 8+ years of professional software engineering experience

assessments.note: About 4 years of experience, short of 8+; distributed systems shown only at small scale.
Python and FastAPI shown; no Java or Spring Boot evidence.
Cloudflare Workers and Wrangler shown; no AWS, Azure, or GCP evidence.
Multiple production AI applications shipped on Cloudflare with LLM integration.
Built a LangGraph agent for Job Fit Agent in production.
RAG and prompting shown; tool calling and human-in-the-loop not clearly evidenced.
Data pipelines shown; no Kafka or event-driven messaging evidence.
Langfuse observability shown; guardrails, eval pipelines, and fallbacks not clearly evidenced.
Led modernization as lead architect; influence without formal authority not explicit.
Client onboarding role implies cross-functional work; communication not directly shown.
Multi-step agents shown; multi-tier memory and recursive reasoning not evidenced.
No healthcare, revenue cycle, billing, or fintech experience in the evidence.
pgvector and semantic search shown; knowledge graph construction not evidenced.
Embeddings used via RAG; no PyTorch, Hugging Face, or fine-tuning evidence.
Founder and Systems Architect driving AI product builds at TYcodes.

output.verdict_line: The candidate has strong applied AI agent and LLM engineering experience but lacks the required Java, Spring Boot, 8+ years, and AWS, Azure, or GCP experience.
top_gaps: Java and Spring Boot production experience
AWS, Azure, or GCP cloud platform experience
